name: com.openugd.configuration
description: Unreleased 0.x, outside the OpenUGD 2.0 release. String-keyed, layered configuration for com.openugd.context: a case-insensitive string-to-string map filled from JSON, dictionaries or settings objects, with explicit overrides on top, typed binding onto plain settings objects, and one opt-in registration, ContextBuilder.AddConfiguration, that makes it resolvable as IConfiguration. Has known open defects; read the README before use.
